    SELECT `id`
    FROM cards
    WHERE `isStorySpotlight` = 1 AND `isTextless` = 0
),
t_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS story_spotlight_count
    FROM c_rows
),
t_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM cards
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT (story_spotlight_count * 100.0 / total_count) AS percentage
    FROM t_count, t_total
),
t_ids AS (
    SELECT `id`
    FROM c_rows
)
SELECT final_result.percentage, t_ids.`id`
FROM t_ids
CROSS JOIN final_result;

    FROM posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.ParentId = u.Id
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT PostId, ParentId, Score, ParentDisplayName
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE ParentId IS NOT NULL
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT c.PostId, c.ParentId, c.Score, c.ParentDisplayName
    FROM c_rows c
    JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
),
t_agg AS (
    SELECT ParentDisplayName, MAX(Score) AS MaxScore
    FROM t_join
    GROUP BY ParentDisplayName
)
SELECT ParentDisplayName
FROM t_agg
ORDER BY MaxScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH race_info AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
    SELECT r.time AS champion_time
    FROM results r
    INNER JOIN race_info ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.position = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT r.time AS last_time
    FROM results r
    INNER JOIN race_info ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r.position DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
times AS (
    SELECT 
        (CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 1, INSTR(champion_time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)) AS champion_milliseconds,
        (CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, 1, INSTR(last_time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 + 
         CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)) AS last_milliseconds
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            champion_time,
            last_time
        FROM champion, last_driver
    )
)
SELECT 
    (CAST((last_milliseconds - champion_milliseconds) * 100.0 / last_milliseconds AS REAL)) AS percentage_faster
FROM times;

1454.sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(e.cost) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE type = 'Meeting')) AS percentage
FROM 
    expense e
JOIN 
    budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN 
    event me ON b.link_to_event = me.event_id
WHERE 
    me.type = 'Meeting';

    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, t.`Price`, t.`Amount`
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON t.`CustomerID` = c.`CustomerID`
    WHERE c.`Currency` LIKE '%Euro%'
    OR c.`Currency` LIKE '%euro%'
    OR c.`Currency` LIKE '%EUR%'
),
t_agg AS (
    SELECT SUM(t.`Amount`) AS total_amount, t.`CustomerID`
    FROM t_rows t
    GROUP BY t.`CustomerID`
)

FROM t_agg t;
